transcript: Speaker A: What are you doing? Speaker B: Ek nayi reel aayi hai, dekhna chahoge? [A new reel has come, do you want to watch?] Speaker A: Galti mat karo, aise bolo. "A new reel just came out, do you want to watch it?" [Don't make a mistake, say it like this. "A new reel just came out, do you want to watch it?"] Speaker B: Oh accha samajh gaya. Ye to kaafi jyada aasan hai. Aapke saath baat karke mujhe aur jyada English bolne ka man kar raha hai. [Oh okay, I understand. This is much easier. Talking to you makes me want to speak more English.] Speaker A: Roz apne free time mein bas das-pandra minute mujhse baat kiya karo. [Just talk to me for 10-15 minutes daily in your free time.] Speaker B: Oh, par main aapse kaha baat kar paunga? [Oh, but where will I be able to talk to you?] Speaker A: Tum abhi ke abhi SpeakX app download kar lo. [You download the SpeakX app right now.] Speaker B: Sach mein? [Really?] Speaker A: Yeh ek AI English teaching app hai. Mere jaise AI teachers yahan English bolna sikhate hain aur practice karwate hain. Tum mujhse koi bhi sawaal pooch sakte ho, mein uska English mein jawab dungi aur practice karne mein madad karungi. Agar tum galti karoge toh ek real human teacher ki tarah use sudhaar dungi. Bas roz practice karna shuru karo. Sirf das-bees dinon ke andar tum bohot acchi English bolne lagoge. [This is an AI English teaching app. AI teachers like me teach English speaking and practice here. You can ask me any question, I will answer in English and help you practice. If you make a mistake, I will correct it like a real human teacher. Just start practicing daily. Within just 10-20 days, you will start speaking very good English.] Speaker B: Par AI teachers hain toh yeh toh kaafi jyada mehanga hoga na? [But since there are AI teachers, it must be very expensive, right?] Speaker A: Yeh India ka sabse sasta English sikhane wala app hai. Aapko sirf 2 rupaye mein 7 dino ka trial bhi mil jayega. [This is India's cheapest English learning app. You will also get a 7-day trial for just 2 rupees.] Speaker B: Arey waah! Yeh toh ekdum best app hai. Main abhi download kar leta hoon. [Oh wow! This is the absolute best app. I will download it right now.]
